acceptanceResults: A1: The CI route remains dynamic across light, standard, and strict profiles and unknown or release-owned paths fail closed without a downgrade.
A2: Rust owns a read-only Contract-aware quality gate bound to repository, Contract, snapshot, route, Agent Risk, and preflight facts without writing .ai records.
A3: The Rust gate emits deterministic identity-bound JSON and yellow or red decisions exit non-zero.
A4: Pull-request CI invokes the Rust gate before repository commands for standard and strict routes while retaining existing Cargo/static shadow checks.
A5: Negative tests cover malformed, foreign, stale, symlink, policy-conflicting, manifest-tampered, route-tampered, and human-review-required inputs, plus read-only byte preservation.
A6: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese documentation describes the dynamic CI boundary, source-build versus immutable Release identity, and deferred workflow comparisons without overclaiming.
A7: Shared Runtime, explicit repository context, visible Outcome, and object/adopter isolation boundaries remain unchanged.
